title: Which physical hardware items does the model define?
task: List the SAF_PhysicalHardware elements in this model. Give the names as the model spells them, including any typos -- a name that looks misspelled is evidence you read the model rather than recalled a catalogue.
rationale: Enumeration is the cheapest honest check that an agent read rows rather than pattern-matched a plausible-sounding answer. The model contains a misspelled name ('HmIP-VDMOT modiefied Long Cable'), which a reciting model will silently correct and a reading model will reproduce.
outcomes: Names at least two real hardware items
